feeds.title: Golf Forever Blog
feeds.description: Our latest articles with useful tips and information on how to create a golf-optimized body and perform your best every time you tee it up. Golf Forever is the digital golf fitness and pain relief program that helps you increase flexibility, get stronger and gain distance to play your best golf. This is your source for tips and simple golf exercises that make up a comprehensive golf fitness program which helps you play your best golf, pain free.

feeds.title: Fit For Golf Blog
feeds.description: Welcome To Fit For Golf. Your resource for all things golf fitness. My goal is to provide education and training support using a blend of science, and practical experience. There is a lot of 'noise' in the golf fitness world. My aim is to filter through this and provide you with information that will help your golf, fitness, and health as efficiently as possible.

feeds.description: The Golf Fitness Coach helps golfers improve their game through strength and conditioning. This page is specifically tailored toward golf fitness.

feeds.title: Roy Khoury Fitness Blog
feeds.description: At Roy Khoury Fitness, I don't provide golf lessons or teach you how to swing. I fill the gap between your golf lessons and your typical gym workouts - to uncover what's holding you back from the next level of performance. Then, I design a fitness and nutrition program to help you reach your goals faster and more efficiently.
